scope: Bounded source-owned Box / Laschen controls plus Joint integer/totient address readout in the existing A0 Orientation Controller Bench; not a whole-machine or scientific acceptance.

tests.method: Actual source modules and inline Janus / Two-Cut scripts with simulated DOM and message delivery; no browser pixels.

implemented: Source-owned READ, CAPTURE, atomic SET, STEP and exact scoped RETURN for t, extension, foldDeg, mode, baseOn and number profile.
Active fold/contact cycle and CON-DAO playback are paused before mutation.
Integer, prime factors, Euler totient and gap are emitted into the existing typed Bench journal.
CON-DAO owns its 14-tick next cursor, displayed tick and timer flag; native CAPTURE stops the timer and exact RETURN restores the paused cursor/display checkpoint.

A permanently open Toy-Store-style hero demo runs a ten-stage tour across Carrier, CRT16 interior, 48-state Player, Double Body / H7, 1111 / Gauss, Spectrum / E8, Fibonacci / Euler, Fold / CON-DAO, exact Contact / Capture and Return. It reveals the existing expert sections while running, reuses their controls, keeps progress and Stop in a floating dock, stops showroom motion before the source-owned exact checkpoint sequence, and yields immediately to trusted manual input.
For 1111, Q4 address 1111 and explicit P0/F10, P1/F26 or P2/F42 layer witnesses are source-selectable and part of Return; other number profiles remain null/HOLD.
Existing A0 package identity and existing Bench entry are reused.
